text:
jas: FYI found another onboarding trap: our Python notebook tutorial and the cookiecutter sample both use `async with RedwoodClient()` without awaiting init. reproducible with tokenfile fallback.
mira: Link to the notebook?
jas: https://github.com/redwood-ai/examples/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb (the cell shows `async with RedwoodClient() as client:` then `await client.generate(...)`).
sam: Ugh, that's the same pattern. Did we already patch the SDK? I saw GH #452 but not sure what landed.
jas: #452 is open, but we still have multiple copies in examples and the cookiecutter template. Also the docs site has a redirect: /python-quickstart -> /python/getting-started (302) and the anchor `#async-notebook` was lost in the redirect so users only see the sync examples.
docs-team: We should treat this as docs drift + SDK bug. Short plan: 1) update examples and cookiecutter to use the safe pattern, 2) patch SDK __aenter__ to await init, 3) add a deploy-time check for docs redirects/anchors.
jas: Minimal repro (notebook-friendly):
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient

async def demo():
    # current quickstart -> immediate AuthenticationError on first request
    async with RedwoodClient() as client:
        await client.generate("hello")
```
Workarounds: `client = RedwoodClient(); await client.init(); async with client:` or use sync client.
support-bot: note: support ticket #8273 references the same symptom: "works with explicit await, fails when copied from notebook". Marked as P2.
mira: Also saw subtle retry header weirdness: first request after enter logs retry-count=0 even though retries should be enabled. probably because the request fired before init populated auth headers. Add an integration test asserting headers and retry metadata.
docs-team: I'll push a small patch to the cookiecutter and examples repo this morning to show the explicit init workaround and submit a docs PR to reinstate the async anchor. Also adding a short note in quickstart: "If using `async with`, ensure client init completes (workaround shown) until SDK v1.4.2 patch ships."
sam: Please grep repo for `async with RedwoodClient` and flag any occurrences. Also check the tutorial notebooks in partner repos (partner-* org) since they copy examples.
jas: Created GH issue refs: examples#129, cookiecutter#22, docs#401. Branches: fix/examples-async-init, fix/cookiecutter-async-init.
docs-team: Added CI check: warn if a docs redirect loses anchors (simple heuristic). filing infra ticket for a stricter check.
support-bot: reminder: link support ticket #8273 -> GH #452 for correlation.
mira: Thanks, good triage. We'll keep this thread for follow-ups.
